description: React component for prefetching channel data in Mattermost, managing prefetch queues, delays, and conditions based on user activity and system events.

classes.name: DataPrefetch
classes.description: React component responsible for prefetching channel data based on various triggers and conditions.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to component props, triggers prefetching and profile loading based on state changes.

methods.name: prefetchPosts
methods.description: Prefetches posts for a specific channel, with optional delay if recent activity is detected.

methods.name: prefetchData
methods.description: Iterates over prefetch queue object to schedule prefetching for channels not yet requested.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns null; component does not render any UI.
